description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Viridian Joiner.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Viridian Joiner.
Repeat.

uses.name: Viridian Joiner
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater
